records.title: 1451 Zatsuti征服Ishalani
records.description: 原文具名征服Ishalani；取其1444两省为最小旧国家范围，战争后的扩张边界未知。 本步骤为可关闭地图假说；选年与整省边界不等于已确证转属日期。原始native/tribal及投影不改。

sourceExpressions: 1451-1465 AA - Zatsuti tangles itself with constant warfare, first conquering Ishalani in 1451, then losing an offensive war against Yassa in 1453-1458 and losing ground in 1456-1460 to Zulburas and Abussas raids. The country ceases to exist in 1465, surrendering to Nazhni.
